verdict.rationale: FFmpeg's core product is an official, extensively documented CLI (ffmpeg, plus ffprobe and ffplay) that handles arbitrary inputs, stream mapping and filtergraphs. Community users describe driving it with LLM-generated commands and loading filtergraphs from files, which shows it works in AI-assisted workflows. Users also call its syntax opaque and complain about shell-escaping friction when assembling complex commands. Missing for 10: evidence of agent-oriented ergonomics such as structured or machine-readable output for automated consumers, and a less error-prone command syntax for complex invocations.
